Thanks for the clear asks — short operational summary for the exec memo:
- Primary runbook gaps: lack of a clear fallback for model-variant mismatch during Dedicated canary (we currently fall back to a best-effort compatible variant but we need a documented SLA for customer-facing cases).
- Mitigations (high priority): 1) short-term: add an explicit "variant-fallback" policy in the router (2 engineer days) + test plan; 2) medium-term: automated canary-monitor that checks tail error+latency signals and auto-routes to hosted API (3 weeks).
- Tracing: enable token-level traces for the canary traffic (privacy review done) — will require a 24-hour retention exception for debug logs (I will coordinate with Security if exec approves).

I've updated the matrix with two prioritized mitigations and estimated effort. Link to the one-pager for QBR slide: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1QBR-slide-deck (draft slide 3).

Decision request for execs: approve pilot commit (2 GPUs for 6 weeks) and a temporary debug retention window (24 hours) during the canary. If approved, Kimberly: can you convert the pilot quote into an order form; Marissa: we'll freeze the canary dates and start smoke tests on 3/14.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Reliability & Ops
